scope: nonUSB upstream clock-configuration selection and runtime system-clock computation; static bytes, retained Ghidra exports and finite integer arithmetic only
supersedes_partially: report/analysis-tools/system-deepening/nonusb-clock-writers/COVERAGE_RESIDUAL.json remaining_static (all-upstream-config-selections, nonusb-pll-decode and full-cfg-coverage are partially advanced)

closed_this_round.detail: 0x20001cfc identified as the HWINFO hwrev field parsed by 0801d888; the range test in 080108ac is hwrev 0x0A87..0x0AFF -> 16 MHz, else 32 MHz.
14-row hwrev threshold table at 0x08025da4, 14 version strings at 0x08024234, loop count byte-proven by cmp r5,#0xe at 0x0801d8cc; cumulative application for all thresholds <= hwrev.
Six init functions bound to two clock config entries with byte-verified Thumb pointer literals; 080108ac has 4 callers, 08010960 has 2.
0800cd24 computes SYSCLK from RCC source/PLL fields; 0800cdb4 applies the 16-entry prescaler shift table at 0x080241cc before writing 0x20000250. The running clock is NOT a hardcoded 64 MHz.
0800e8b4 uses 0800cd24 for USART baud-rate generation, so the clock value affects peripheral timing beyond SysTick.
106 fatal-error call references quantified by 4 KB segment with four sampled contexts; confirms 08008c04 is a generic entry, not clock-specific.

remaining_static.detail: Only 4 of 14 version setters were inspected. A complete string <-> threshold <-> setter <-> init-pointer mapping is not established; the string order (K10 before K05) differs from the numeric threshold order.
0x0800fd25 and 0x0800fd31 (thresholds 0x0A87 / 0x0A90) have no decoded function body in the retained project; a range export found no instructions at those addresses.

The PLL configuration written by writer 2 (0800c8dc) and the config structs in 080108ac / 08010960 were not decoded into an actual running core frequency. The USB-side 64 MHz conclusion remains un-reproduced for nonUSB.
hwrev / sku values are not bound to a marketing model, board type or physical oscillator. HWINFO parse reads an in-image factory block, not a device measurement.
Time between RCC register writes and SysTick reconfiguration, lost or slowed ticks, reload already written while old step byte restored, and timeout loops depending on the same software tick.
6782 instruction rows over 5051 unique addresses in the exported regions are not full-program control-flow coverage; only 4 of 106 fatal-error callers were sampled.
